_doc: Per-probe cleaned observations (threat-2 fix). Key '{vendor}_{num}' -> list of factual observation lines (case_id + action + raw result). Verdict language ('defect if'/'claim'/'FP note'/'expect'/'should'/'BUG'/'correct:') removed; all factual content (action, http status, code, response) preserved. gen_glm_prompts.py prefers this over raw load_log when the key is present. Reviewed individually 2026-08-13.
